And at the COP31 climate summit, environmental advocates are warning against waste incineration, arguing that it risks locking African cities into expensive and polluting infrastructure.

items.title: Fears of rising antisemitism in Europe
items.desc: Holocaust survivor Regina Sluszny commemorates the victims of Auschwitz as Jewish communities across Europe face growing hostility. What does the promise of "Never Again" mean for Jewish life in Europe today?
